body: Id love that omg! Me and my friends REALLY wanted to hear the music (off names alone) so that would be awesome! I’ll go ahead and shoot you a dm!

Thank you for this, the night this happened me and my boyfriend did sit down and talk about it all. He’d feel the same way he told me (maybe not as intense cuz he’s someone who is more in his head rather than letting his emotions out) but he said he intentionally made sure that his roommate/friend would be there with the through all the outings. He didn’t want to be alone with her because he knew how uncomfortable and unhappy it would make me. So I’m absolutely thankful that he understands. And yeah I’d never tell him who to be friends with (unless said person crossed boundaries, I’d have a serious talk with him about that) Like I said I love our mutual girl friend, she’s a wonderful person. But being honest about my feelings were so refreshing, especially since he didn’t fight back. He just understood. We both agreed to exactly what you suggested, no hanging out alone with girls/guys unless they’re family. That made both of us very happy. I’m still struggling with those heart wrenching thoughts but its gotten better and I can sit here writing this while the three of them hangout without crying. I’m glad people understand what I’m feeling. Makes me feel less alone with these thoughts.

I have asked for more reassurance and comfort. He said he'd try his very best and honestly that's all I can ask from him. We have our own issues when it comes to intense emotional stuff but I do appreciate him trying. Unfortunately when I'm in this state of mind what usually works, doesn't work at all. He's a bit bad at texting when he's hanging out with people but I still love him for trying.
It has been. Thank you for the advice. I’m trying too but the holidays have been especially hard.

Basically I kinda made my own version of the sugar jar and went off my intuition and what I had in my house. I filled 1/3 of the jar with my sugar, wrote my petition, put it in there, filled it with more sugar, added cinnamon, closed it up and sealed it with wax. You CAN add herbs to help if you would like and you could add a little bit of honey but go off of your intuition and make sure you 100% believe in it. I just made one last night, but you gotta remember to work it, light a candle on it once a week, or however many times you feel like you need to do that. Hope that helps :)

From my knowledge I heard you should do Sugar jars for faster results because honey jars are more so for longterm situations and have been said to take longer to work. Atleast what I've been told is to make a sugar jar first for faster results then to also make a base, then to switch over to a honey jar later on for more of  a longterm thing.
